subject: Part of results from ULS and DWLS estimators are different

messages.author: 2368ae49227cd233
messages.subject: Part of results from ULS and DWLS estimators are different
parts:
Hi all,

I estimated my bifactor model with these two estimators. The results turn out to be very similar to each other for the most part. But there are several factor loading estimates differ quite a lot. Under these circumstances, is there a guideline as to which of these estimators should be chosen (i.e., more reliable)?

I noticed one paper on Structural Equation Modeling in 2009 suggests ULS over DWLS (see below). So any thoughts on this issue?

https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/10705510903203573

Thank you,
Chao
